node.name: samesite cookies
node.rich_text:
Difference Same Site vs Same origin:
Same Site Cookie restriction levels: - Strict Only when its exactly from the same site -> otherwise it wont be sent - Lax Only in GET method and CLICK NOT in POST (usually to modify data) aswell as iframes, scripts references to images etc - None Basically disables Same Site Cookie restrictions
Default goes to Lax -> some but not all.
Can be set manually: - Set-Cookie: session=0F8tgdOhi9ynR1M9wa3ODa; SameSite=Strict - If you set it none you need also set Secure (https only) or it will be ignored - Set-Cookie: trackingId=0F8tgdOhi9ynR1M9wa3ODa; SameSite=None; Secure
